places.name: São Vicente
past: Planted by the landing about a largo, with the Sé and the câmara on it, and a short grid of streets along the shore.
The old tower keep was rebuilt as a great castle on the same ground.
The parish church was pulled down and rebuilt on its own ground as a great minster.

places.name: Vau de Sal
past: Planted on the height above the landing: the upper town about its largo, with the Sé and the câmara, and a short grid of streets along the brow; below, the landing’s warehouses and its rua direita along the shore, and steep ladeiras between them.

places.name: Vaupereira
past: Settled on the riverbank for the water and the fishing.
